name: NCF-SE 2023 - Mathematics, Middle Stage
description: Illustrative sample modelled on the National Curriculum Framework for School Education 2023 (Curricular Goals, Competencies, Learning Outcomes). The fractions chain below is grounded in CG-1.
subject: Mathematics

curricularGoals.statement: Understands numbers (whole numbers, integers, fractions, rational numbers), represents them, and performs operations on them fluently.

competencies.statement: Represents rational numbers on the number line and compares and orders them.
learningOutcomes: Locates positive and negative rational numbers on a number line.
Compares two rational numbers and justifies the comparison.

competencies.statement: Performs the four arithmetic operations on fractions and integers and applies them in context.
learningOutcomes: Adds and subtracts fractions with unlike denominators.
Identifies equivalent fractions such as 2/4 and 1/2.

name: NCF-SE 2023 - Science, Middle Stage
description: Illustrative science curriculum document for the plant-part chain. Goals name the structures a labelled diagram is drawn to show.
subject: Science

curricularGoals.statement: Explains how the parts of a plant carry out the work the organism needs.

competencies.statement: Names the visible parts of a flowering plant on a labelled diagram.
learningOutcomes: Points to leaf, root, stem, and flower on a standard diagram.
Uses the diagram's labels rather than inventing new names.

competencies.statement: States the function of a named plant part.
learningOutcomes: Connects the leaf to food-making and the root to water uptake.
